# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user.

# Single-cell analysis - tumor classification

Here, we will perform the third single cell analysis steps, including tumor phenotyping.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_04.rds")
sce
```

## Filter sce for tumor cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on analysis category
sce <- sce[,sce$analysis_cat == "tumor"]
sce
```

Optional normalization (NOT PERFORMED HERE)

```{r}
# # 99.7 quantile normalization 
# library(spatialEco)
# assay(sce, "exprs_tu") <- t(apply(assay(sce,"exprs"), MARGIN = 1, function(x) winsorize(x,p=c(0,0.997))))
# 
# #Min-max [0,1] scaling of arcsinh-transformed counts only in tumor compartment
assay(sce, "min_max_tu") <- assay(sce, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs"))
assay(sce, "min_max_tu") <- assay(sce, "min_max_tu") / (rowMaxs(assay(sce, "exprs")) - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs")))
```

```{r}
# max(assay(sce["MYC",], "exprs"))
# max(assay(sce["MYC",], "exprs_tu"))
min(assay(sce["CA9",], "min_max_tu"))
min(assay(sce["CA9",], "min_max"))
quantile(assay(sce["CA9",], "exprs"))
quantile(assay(sce["CA9",], "min_max_tu"))
quantile(assay(sce["CA9",], "min_max"))
```

# 1. Clustering

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# We will again use predefined markers 
# Option 1 (We further remove CD140b): 
rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("GPX4", "HLADR", "NFKB", "CyclinD1", "HIF1a", "p53", "MYC", 
"ICAM1", "PDK4", "CD73", "BRG1", "PKM2", "PDL1", "CD10", 
"IDH2", "HIF2a", "AuroraKinaseA", "Tim3", "EGFR", "S6", "VEGFR1", 
"VHL", "RB1", "mTOR", "GLUT1", "Fumarase", "GLUD1_2")


#Option 2: min-max scaled tumor_cluster

#Option 3: Remove noisy markers and markers with low changes
# rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster_1 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("HLADR", "CyclinD1", "p53", "MYC", 
# "ICAM1", "PDK4", "PKM2", "CD10", "HIF2a", "Tim3", "EGFR", "S6", "VEGFR1", "CD73",
# "VHL", "RB1", "mTOR", "GLUT1", "Fumarase", "GLUD1_2")

rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster_1 <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CA9","panCK","GPX4", "HLADR", "NFKB", "CyclinD1", "HIF1a", "p53", "MYC", 
"ICAM1", "PDK4", "CD73", "BRG1", "PKM2", "PDL1", "CD10", 
"IDH2", "HIF2a", "AuroraKinaseA", "Tim3", "EGFR", "S6", "VEGFR1", 
"VHL", "RB1", "mTOR", "GLUT1", "Fumarase", "GLUD1_2") #include CA9 and panCK as well

#Option 4: min-max scaled tumor_cluster_1
```

## Run clustering

### Graph-based 

Next, we will run Rphenoannoy (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters. 

```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

tu_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$tu_cluster_30 <- tu_clusters

unique(sce$tu_cluster_30)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")

gc()

#k=50
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 50)

tu_clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$tu_cluster_50 <- tu_clusters
```

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")
```

```{r}
#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$tu_cluster_30,sce$tu_cluster_50, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$tu_cluster_50,sce$tu_cluster_70, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$tu_cluster_70,sce$tu_cluster_90, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$tu_cluster_90,sce$tu_cluster_110, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$tu_cluster_110,sce$tu_cluster_130, mode = "index")
```

```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# #Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
tu_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"tu_cluster_[:digit:]")]
tu_clusters <- tu_clusters[!str_detect(tu_clusters, "_1_")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(tu_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(tu_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]),
           sil = mean(sil$width),
           rmsd = mean(rmsd),
           type = "tumor_cluster")
}

tu_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"tu_cluster_mm_[:digit:]")]
tu_clusters <- tu_clusters[!str_detect(tu_clusters, "_1_")]

df_1 <- foreach(i = seq_along(tu_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(tu_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]),
           sil = mean(sil$width),
           rmsd = mean(rmsd, na.rm = TRUE),
           type = "tumor_cluster_mm")
}

tu_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"tu_cluster_1_[:digit:]")]

df_2 <- foreach(i = seq_along(tu_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(tu_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,4]),
           sil = mean(sil$width),
           rmsd = mean(rmsd),
           type = "tumor_cluster_1")
}

tu_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"tu_cluster_mm_1_[:digit:]")]

df_3 <- foreach(i = seq_along(tu_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "min_max")), clusters=colData(sce)[,tu_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(tu_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,5]),
           sil = mean(sil$width),
           rmsd = mean(rmsd, na.rm = TRUE),
           type = "tumor_cluster_mm_1")
}

df_out <- rbind(df, df_1, df_2, df_3)


p1 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")


p3 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
p1+p2+p3 
```

### Visualization 

```{r}
# By cluster 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_mm_1_110, #select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster_1)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu")), col = viridis(100), clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu"))))+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))

mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_mm_90, #select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max_tu",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu")), col = viridis(100), clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu"))))+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))

mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_mm_130, #select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max_tu",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu")), col = viridis(100),clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max_tu"))))+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))
```

### cytoviewer visualization

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
```

```{r}
# Select images of interest
set.seed(2201)
cur_sample <- sample(unique(sce$sample_id), 30)

cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, tumor_metacluster_names) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% filter(tumor_metacluster_names == "mTORhi_VHL_PKM2hi") %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(sample_id))[1:10]

cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
```


```{r}
library(cytoviewer)
cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, img_id = "sample_id", cell_id = "ObjectNumber")
```


# 2. Quality control 

Kick out low expressing cluster

```{r}
var <- modelGeneCV2(sce[rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster,], assay.type = "exprs")
var <- var %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(desc(ratio))

var_1 <- modelGeneVar(sce[rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster,], assay.type = "exprs")
var_1 <- var_1 %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(desc(bio))
```

```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
# Cluster channel marker correlation (all markers - does not show distribution which is usually recommended)
cor_sce <- as.data.frame(t(assay(sce,"exprs")[rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster,]))

cor_sce <- as.data.frame(t(assay(sce,"min_max")[rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster,]))

corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,# Add coefficient of correlation
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40, #Text label color and rotation
         # Combine with significance
         #p.mat = , sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=F
)
```

## Add metadata 

```{r}
## Read in metadata
metadata_general <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas_full/projects/RCC_DL/metadata_general.csv")

## Add to sce
sce$genomic_subtype <- metadata_general$genomic_subtype[match(sce$PID, metadata_general$PID)]
sce$genomic_risk <- metadata_general$genomic_risk[match(sce$PID, metadata_general$PID)]
sce$metabolic_subtype <- metadata_general$metabolic_subtype_name[match(sce$PID, metadata_general$PID)]

## UPDATE PDL1 score (from T cell panel)
sce$PDL1_score <- metadata_general$PDL1_score[match(sce$PID, metadata_general$PID)]
```

### Testing 

NOTE: Extensive evaluation of tu_clus_mm_90 and tu_clus_130 (chosen) 

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")
```

```{r}
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_130, #select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max", #for metaclustering we use min_max and not exprs
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")), 
        col = viridis(100),
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))))+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))

# QC: we kick out the low expressing cluster (reduces total tumor cell number slightly)
sce <- sce[,!sce$tu_cluster_130 == "71"]
```


```{r}
#Check metacluster stability measures

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$tu_cluster_selected <- match(sce$tu_cluster_130, unique(sort(sce$tu_cluster_130)))

mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster)



library(clValid)

#Internal measures
set.seed(22)
testCL<- clValid(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),nClust = 4:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward", maxitems = 5000)
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)

#Stability measures 
testCL_1<- clValid(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),nClust = 4:20,clMethods = c("hierarchical","agnes","kmeans"),validation="stability",metric="euclidean", method = "ward", maxitems = 3000)
summary(testCL_1)
plot(testCL_1, legend = FALSE)

#chosen method: kmeans, k=14
```



```{r}
# # Agnes
# set.seed(22)

# avg_col_dend_MCP <- color_branches(avg_dend_obj_MCP, k = 11)
# plot(avg_col_dend_MCP)


# k-means 
set.seed(22)
h_k <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = viridis(100),
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        row_km = 13, row_km_repeats = 10000, 
        #cluster_rows = avg_col_dend_MCP,
        #row_split = 11,
        name = "Mean expression")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))), clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))

h_select <- draw(h_k)

## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_select)
anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,ncells)
anno$metacluster <- NA
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$metacluster <- as.factor((ifelse(anno$tu_cluster_selected %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i,anno$metacluster)))
}

## Add to sce
sce$tumor_metacluster <- anno$metacluster[match(sce$tu_cluster_selected, anno$tu_cluster_selected)]
mean_sce$tumor_metacluster_1 <- anno$metacluster[match(mean_sce$tu_cluster_selected, anno$tu_cluster_selected)]
```

### Rich heatmap 

Heatmap of clusters

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$tu_cluster_selected <- match(sce$tu_cluster_130, unique(sort(sce$tu_cluster_130)))
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$tumor_cluster)

state_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$tu_cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rownames(sce) %in% c("CA9", "panCK"))

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over tu_cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, tu_cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-tu_cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(tu_cluster_selected = spatial$tu_cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")


### 2.2 Metadata features

#Number of cells per tu_cluster_selected 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(tu_cluster_selected, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 1 cell)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,PID) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>=5) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of ISUP_combined grade per cluster
ISUP_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,ISUP_combined) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tu_cluster_selected,names_from = ISUP_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of pT_combined stage per cluster
pT_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,pT_combined) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT_combined <- pT_combined %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT_combined <- pT_combined %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tu_cluster_selected,names_from = pT_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,necrose) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tu_cluster_selected,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")

PDL1_score <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,PDL1_score) %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% group_by(tu_cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tu_cluster_selected,names_from = PDL1_score,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_barplot(ISUP_combined, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined)),
                            pT_combined = anno_barplot(pT_combined, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined)),
                            necrose = anno_barplot(necrose, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose)),
                            PDL1_score = anno_barplot(PDL1_score, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 3. Define broader categories - Metacluster
anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(tumor_metacluster)

#Create colors for tumor metacluster
n <- length(unique(anno$tumor_metacluster))
meta_col <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"Paired"))(length(unique(anno$tumor_metacluster))), 
                      unique(anno$tumor_metacluster))

metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster <- meta_col

### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "exprs",
        row_title = NULL,
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        show_row_dend = TRUE,
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  TRUE,
        row_split = anno$tumor_metacluster,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        cluster_row_slices = TRUE)+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))))+
  Heatmap(t(assay(state_sce, "min_max")), col = col_main)+
  rowAnnotation(metacluster = anno_simple(unfactor(anno$tumor_metacluster), col = metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster, border = TRUE))+
  #rowAnnotation(names = anno_text(anno$tu_cluster_names))+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta


# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster), 
               legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster))
 
#lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "astir/GMM", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$tu_astir_col), 
#               legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$tu_astir_col))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```

```{r}
        show_column_names =  TRUE,
        row_split = anno$tumor_metacluster,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        cluster_row_slices = TRUE)+
  #Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))))+
  #Heatmap(t(assay(state_sce, "min_max")), col = col_main)+
  rowAnnotation(metacluster = anno_simple(unfactor(anno$tumor_metacluster), col = metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster, border = TRUE))+
  rowAnnotation(names = anno_text(anno$tumor_metacluster_names))+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster), 
               legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$tumor_metacluster))

# Draw heatmap
pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/tumor_panel/TU_metacluster_heatmap.pdf", width = 10.5, height = 3.5)
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
dev.off()
```

#### Fraction correlation 

```{r}
# METACLUSTER 

## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tumor_metacluster,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_metacluster <- SID_metacluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_metacluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_metacluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tumor_metacluster,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tumor_metacluster")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_metacluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_metacluster_cor) 
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_metacluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_metacluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_metacluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_metacluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_metacluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of metacluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_metacluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_metacluster_cor_plot

#CLUSTER 
## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_cluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tu_cluster_selected,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_cluster <- SID_cluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_cluster_cor <- SID_cluster
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_cluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_cluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_cluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = tu_cluster_selected,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("tu_cluster_selected")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_cluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_cluster_cor) 
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_cluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_cluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_cluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

SID_cluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_cluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of cluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_cluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_cluster_cor_plot
```

#### Dimensionality reduction 

##### TSNE / UMAP

```{r dim_red}
## Subsample 10% of cells from each core
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots

#Run UMAP/TSNE
set.seed(220195)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce[,sub]

reducedDim(sce_sub, "TSNE") <- calculateTSNE(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$tumor_cluster,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 5,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "tu_cluster_selected")
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "tumor_metacluster")
```

#### CATALYST-based visualization

We will first convert the sce into a CATALYST-compatible format.

```{r CATALYST}
library(CATALYST)
# save spe in CATALYST-compatible object with renamed colData entries and 
# new metadata information
sce_cat <- sce 
sce_cat$sample_id <- factor(sce$PID)
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$tumor_metacluster)

#add celltype information to metadata
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(tumor_metacluster = factor(sce_cat$tumor_metacluster))
```

```{r CATALYST pbmds and clrDR, message=FALSE}
# MDS pseudobulk by tumor_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$tumor_cluster], 
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "tumor_metacluster", assay = "min_max") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$tumor_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

# MDS pseudobulk by tumor_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "both", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$tumor_cluster], 
      k = "tumor_metacluster",
      size_by = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$tumor_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()

# CLR of patient proportions per tumor_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "tumor_metacluster", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$tumor_metacluster, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()

# CLR of tumor_metacluster proportions per patient
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "sample_id", point_col = "sample_id",
      k = "tumor_metacluster", point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$tumor_metacluster)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
row_order_h_com
```

# 7. Differential abundance analysis 

## Progression

### tumor cluster

```{r}
sce$tu_cluster_names <- sce$tu_cluster_selected
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$tu_cluster_names), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x = cluster, y = category, col = logFC, size = -log10(FDR))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 10)) +
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out, shape = 1, aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

# 8. Survival analysis 

## Cox hazard models

## tumor metacluster 

### Mean

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tumor_metacluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "tumor_metacluster_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("TU_", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
```

### Median

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tumor_metacluster_names,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_tumor_metacluster_names <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_tumor_metacluster_names %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "tumor_metacluster_names",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("TU_", colnames(Cox_df))

## Based on categories (median or median division of cluster proportions) 
Cox_df_median <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(median = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > median(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(median)
}

colnames(Cox_df_median) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_median) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_median <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_median)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_median$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_median$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_median$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_median$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_median$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_median$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_median$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_median),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
covariates <- Cox_df_median %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months,) %>% colnames

multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_median)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_median <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_median <- ggplot(plot_df_median, aes(x = reorder(group,-HR), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_median")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_median
```

```{r, fig.height=10}
hr_median/hr_mean
```

```{r}
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

multi_res$coefficients
```

### Cluster-level

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(FDR)")
```

```{r}
cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique() 

cur_surv$CD163 <- Cox_df_mean$CD163[match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
cur_surv$HLADR_hi_CD11c <- Cox_df_mean$HLADR_hi_CD11c[match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
 
#Plot specific survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ CD163, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)

#Plot survival curves
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ HLADR_hi_CD11c, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  data.frame(group = x, p = fit$pvalue, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.1, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(FDR)")
```

```{r}
cur_surv$TU_13 <- Cox_df_mean$MC13[match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = "Set1",
          conf.int = TRUE
)
```
